# The shared laws on the grammar

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`shared-laws-on-the-grammar` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](shared-laws-on-the-grammar.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The five shared laws hold on the grammar for every carrier and relation: closure, finite runs (return, being drawn, rest, ends on lines), lumping and widening, with the models' laws proved from them. Balance is represented both ways as pairings of unit lists, near-definitional, and not derived.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Closure. Lying within a relation's closure (every region closed under it that holds x holds y) is being x or reached from x. The closure is reflexive, transitive, holds every step, grows with the relation, is symmetric for a symmetric one and closed, nothing within it bears the relation beyond it, and a region is x's closure exactly where it holds x, is closed and lies within it. Under the converse it is the closure read backward; a closure through borrowed steps (each step of R′ a step of R, or a step of R from a taken at o) lies within o's or a's closure under R, and where R′ holds R and a lies within o's closure under R′, the two lie within o's closure under R′. A region of the steps of time that every step keeps holds from where it holds on: the closure at the successor along a line. 4. Balance at one step. A perfect pairing of two finite lists under a relation conserves count; under the one it is exactly equal count, and under the empty relation equal count gives none. Lists paired from what comes in (before, given) to what goes on (after, taken) have after + taken = before + given, and every four numbers with that equation are lengths of unit lists so paired under the one. Near-definitional. Counting a region's units (a region read as a test, a modelling choice), a pairing keeps the count on every region not gone out of either way, which is exactly a region the relation does not cross and one closed under it and its converse, closed one way not being enough; under a class decided by a test a pairing is exactly equal count in every class, and the class does work (equal count pairs under the one, not under sameness), so a pairing under continuation relative to such a class keeps the count in every class. The census of a step: units listed once before and after it, under a continuation fixing successors and predecessors, pair those before with those arising to those after with those ceasing, each pair a continuation or the same unit, and where the predecessors of the units after stand before and the successors of the units before stand after, arising and ceasing are beginning and ending. Counted, the census needs no decision of identity: under a continuation fixing successors, the units listed once after a step with those a test marks as ceasing are at most the units before with those a test marks as arising, the tests asking only, as far as can be refuted, that a unit marked as ceasing has no successor after and that a unit after not marked as arising has a predecessor before; its mirror holds under a continuation fixing predecessors, and where both are fixed the two meet in the census's count, the tests read off its decision. Each is the corollary of a local form beside it that asks no split (no merge) only among the listed units. The listing and the test are supplied. 8. Steps counted. n + 1 steps are n steps and then the last. Within m steps and then within n is within m + n, and within n steps is n steps each of which stays or steps. A course of regions each of whose rounds holds exactly what every condition held at the round before holds at round n exactly where everything reaching in n steps held at the start: n rounds of taking on along a relation are one taking on along its n steps. With memory, every round also keeping what it held, it holds exactly where everything reaching within n steps held, the law without memory under staying or a step. Steps split as they compose, and steps read backward are steps of the converse; n steps end where they began or at what the start reaches. Where whatever is reached in fewer than n steps has a successor as far as can be refuted, n steps exist as far as can be refuted, and an unending line has steps of every length. 10. Being drawn. For every relation, x is drawn in exactly where it reaches something that does not reach back, and with a successor that does not reach itself it is drawn. With the successor fixed at what x reaches, x reaching itself is not drawn, and with some successor drawn is not reaching itself; the global forms follow. Witnesses: neither hypothesis can be omitted, and the global one is more than the law uses. 11. Return. Along a line whose places a list holds, merging nothing at its places brings it back to its start within the list's length, by pigeonhole with no decidability, so its start reaches itself; with the successor fixed at what its start reaches, its last place does. On a listed carrier with a successor everywhere, merging nothing makes every place reach itself, and under a fixed successor the two are one. 13. Rest. Where the steps of a line from T are steps of Q (no rise), and every course of Q steps then an F step (a least fall) ends from its place there, the F steps do not recur, as far as can be refuted and outright, with no decision and no choice. The ending is sufficient, not what rest is. Rest is not being drawn either way: a fixed point at rest and not drawn, a place drawn while its marked steps recur. 15. Lumping. E goes alike under R (R˘;E;R ⊆ E) where E-alike places go to E-alike ones. With the successor fixed where E leads, constancy is exactly going alike with a successor available there; the global forms are corollaries. With a successor everywhere, a class that goes alike inside a relation lies in the relation's core, and a class going alike in its own; with a fixed successor a class's core goes alike, so with both it is the coarsest class inside the class that does, and off a fixed successor it need not; going alike keeps lines of every length alike, and a map's image has a fixed successor exactly where sameness under the map goes alike. A map preserves a relation exactly where its image lies within the other. 17. Widening. Widening of relations (including and exceeding) is irreflexive, one-way and transitive and excludes keeping the same and being mixed; keeping is pointwise equivalence and symmetric, mixed symmetric. Where inclusion or exceeding is decided both ways one of the four cases holds, and deciding it for every pair of relations is exactly excluded middle. For any two relations, a transitive relation joined to the strict part of a transitive relation containing it is transitive, and irreflexive where the first is. 19. Ends on lines. Occurrences listed once, each without a successor and within the closure of a member of a list, number at most the list where two successors of an occurrence a member reaches, each leading to a listed occurrence, are one, with no decision; on the grammar, endings on lines from a list and, at the converse, beginnings on lines to a list number at most the list, the reaching only not refuted where it must be. At stages, each step of the continuation one stage on and the units a region nothing outside continues into: with a list covering the units at one stage (holding every unit of the region there), no unit continuing as two units and nothing beginning over a stretch after the stage, the units ending in the stretch number at most the list, with no decision; mirrored, in a region nothing in it continues out of, with nothing merging and nothing ending in a stretch, the units beginning in it number at most a list covering its end. Through them, with lists covering arbitrarily late stages, endings recurring leave beginnings never stopping, and with each unit after the list's stage decided to begin or to have a predecessor, endings recurring give beginnings recurring; with lists of a bounded length covering every stage from some stage on and nothing merging, beginnings recurring leave endings never stopping, and with each unit decided to end or to have a successor, endings recur. The census of a run is a case: from some step on, nothing splitting and every predecessor of a unit listed after a step listed before it, endings recurring among the listed units need beginnings recurring among the units listed after a step, the beginnings decided by a test; its units read as occurrences at stages, the list at a stage covers it, and the test decides a finite search by the count. Stronger: two hypotheses dropped, the units after each step listed once and a test of endings. 20. The models' laws of closure, return, being drawn, rest at amounts, lumping and widening are proved from these in their own modules, each keeping its name and statement: board rule 9, the general law below proving the special one, with no second proof left beside it. The list lemmas the models held, pigeonhole among them, are now names of the grammar's one proof. Among them: structure and change are one lumping, the image law on a determined law's one move; the case split of the step back of a returning configuration, the grammar's decomposition of reach, by which every loss passes a juncture; the repetition of the lasso of a world a list holds, a loop then d steps leading where d steps lead under a fixed successor, its bound pigeonhole; and the lagged orders of courses and of what can be reached, from the relation laws. And the models' step-indexed laws: giving that waits on giving, with memory and without, from the laws of taking on, a chain of waits read as the grammar's steps; and a course carrying every bound on realizing a bundle together, from the composition of within, a trace read as the grammar's steps; and an unending line reaching an occurrence at every later step, from its steps of every length, k steps advancing the index by k; and the inductions over steps that keep a region, from a region every step keeps holding from where it holds on: never arising from an inactive start being never active, activity and presence kept back, an ending kept, a name kept over a held stretch, and a carrier and the pattern's line traced back; and the lineage laws under a continuation, a lineage read as the grammar's steps of the continuation within activity: reaching at most one formation at each step without splits and starting from one without merges, splitting as its steps split, going on where nothing ceases and back where nothing arises, as far as can be refuted, and a lineage being a line under activity and a line from an active occurrence a lineage; and the image of a step along a projection the least process the step factors through, from preserving read through the image. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- None beyond the grammar and the models' representation: every carrier and relation, counting entering only through finite lists as in the models. Each global form takes a fixed successor, merging nothing, a successor everywhere or a list of the carrier, as a corollary of a local form that asks it only where the proof uses it.
- The bridges read each anchor at its model's relation: a process's steps, a law's map, what a level path or a listed course admits as a coreflexive relation, a flow's levels, takes and gives as lists of units, and an amount's no rise and least fall as steps.
- Counting reads a region, the class counted in and a continuation each as a test to Bool (a modelling choice; a proposition enters by decide), and the census of a step lists the units before and after once each; counted, the census reads arising and ceasing (along a run, beginnings) by tests on the listed units in place of a test of the continuation.
- The forms at stages read the units at stages, each step of the continuation one stage on (discrete steps, a modelling choice), and the units a region whose conditions are closed regions: nothing outside it continuing into it, and for the mirror nothing in it continuing out of it; a list covers a stage where it holds every unit of the region there.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That any model's relation is functional, total or listed: the models supply these, and the global forms take them as hypotheses.
- A derivation of balance: the pairing is supplied by the representation rather than drawn from the unfolding, and gives no trajectory of units; balance's consumers keep their arithmetic.
- A converse of the law of rest, from rest along a line to the ending of the courses: none is established, and one would have to say which step relations it compares and on what logic. Witness: `Becoming.«尽则不或屡»`.
- That rest is a case of being drawn, or being drawn a case of rest. Witness: `Becoming.«止而不入之例»`.
- That a pairing under continuation adds anything to equal count beyond what is now stated, the count on every region it does not cross and, under a class decided by a test, in every class; or the n-step law for lines of different lengths.
- The models' other laws on the grammar: they are proved on their models and not yet restated on it.
- That the anchors Branching.Returns, Branching.Lossless, GoAlikeUnder, Web.Widens and Weighting.WidensOn are their grammar terms by definition: each is equivalent to its grammar term by a representation theorem, not equal to it by rfl, and none is redefined (OU3c's audit).
- That C's extension on the paths of a web is a case of the grammar's widening (Web.paths_extension_iff_widens, Direction.extension_iff_widens, Web.paths_comparison_widens, and Web.paths_one_object, which also takes the next item): its content is a reindexing of claims, (formation, step), to admissions, (step, formation), with every claim counted; widening enters by its definition, and reaching the grammar would need a transport of «广» along the swap of a pair, adding machinery and no content.
- That the reduction of what has significance to what can form under the continuation condition is a law of the grammar (Web.widens_iff_retains_adds): the free significance is not lifted to the root.
- That widening being, on a finite listing, what every additive weighting positive on each listed item ranks higher is a law of the grammar (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive): the grammar has no weights.
- That a part whose law is determined, forming its own move, carries a law of its own by a law of the grammar (PartForms.goAlike): its content is the model's premise, the part's law determined at a move the part alone forms. The image law only reads the conclusion as carrying a law of its own (carries_law_iff); a proof through it applies the law and undoes it, and constancy with a fixed successor would need the rest to step and be determined (OU3d's review).
- **Counterexample:** Equal count without a pairing: under the empty relation two one-place lists have one length and no pairing («等长而不对之例»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarLaws.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Drawn and returning where the successor is not fixed («入而返之例»); returning and not drawn with no fixed successor anywhere («非定后返而不入之例»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarLaws.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Rest is not being drawn: a line that falls once and then stays at a fixed point is at rest, and that place is not drawn («止而不入之例»), and along the successor on the whole numbers 0 is drawn while its marked steps recur («入而屡之例»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarLaws.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

Statements unchanged but, per the history, laws taken to any universe, renames, one law widened, an instance dropped from eight laws, two hypotheses dropped from the census of a run. <a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

A derivation of balance where a model's balance is read under a relation other than the one, pairings composing along a supplied conditioning; the models' other central laws restated on the grammar; a converse of the law of rest with the step relations it compares and its logic stated; review by a person.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Closure is the reflexive-transitive closure of a relation read as the least closed region; balance on the grammar is the cardinality reading of a natural-number equation by a bijection of finite lists; return and being drawn are the finite-state facts of a relation's paths, by pigeonhole; going alike (R˘;E;R ⊆ E) is the relational condition under which a quotient of a deterministic system is again one, as in lumpability; widening is strict inclusion with a witness. The readings are the AI's, in development/ou3b-master-laws-on-the-grammar (DESIGN, OU3b2-NOTES, AUDIT), with its three reviews.
